opportunities.name: Book unit note: Gutenberg book + IMDb film adaptation
opportunities.description: For a given classic book title, look it up on Project Gutenberg (author, download count), find its film adaptation on IMDb (year, rating), and save a 'Unit:' note summarizing both.
steps: On Project Gutenberg, click 'Search books', type {book_title} and press Enter
Open the matching book result; record author and download count
On IMDb, click 'Search IMDb' (select all to clear), type {book_title} and press Enter
Open the chosen film adaptation result; record release year and rating
In Notes, click 'New note' and type 'Unit: {book_title} by {author} ({downloads} downloads). Film: {year}, rated {rating}', press Enter

instances.values: Frankenstein — Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley, 160188 downloads; film 2025, 7.4
Pride and Prejudice — Jane Austen, 192356 downloads; film 'Pride & Prejudice' 2005, 7.8
Treasure Island — Robert Louis Stevenson, 35366 downloads; film 1990, 7.0 (interleaved with Morocco Wikipedia search)

opportunities.name: Country geography note: Wikipedia facts + capital local time
opportunities.description: For a given country, look up its capital, population, languages and currency on Wikipedia, get the current local time in the capital on timeanddate, and save a 'Geography:' note.
steps: On Wikipedia, click 'Search Wikipedia', type {country} and press Enter
From the article, record capital, population, official languages and currency
On timeanddate, click 'Search for city or place…', type {capital} and press Enter
Click the result '{country}, {capital}' and record the current time and time zone
In Notes, click 'New note' and type 'Geography: {country}, capital {capital}, pop {population}, {languages}, {currency}, time now {time} {tz}', press Enter

instances.values: Peru — capital Lima, pop 34,157,732, Spanish/Quechua/Aymara, PEN, 12:55:16 PET
Vietnam — capital Hanoi, pop 102,300,000, Vietnamese, VND, 01:00:03 ICT (several mistyped searches first)
Morocco — capital Rabat, pop 36,828,330, Arabic and Amazigh, MAD, 18:05:56 GMT

opportunities.name: Viator museum ticket search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for admission tickets to a given museum and open the top matching ticket/tour listing.
steps: On Viator, click the 'Search for a place or activity' box and select all (ctrl+a) to clear it
Click the most relevant ticket/tour listing to view its details

instances.values: Natural History Museum tickets → Field Museum of Natural History Admission Tickets
Louvre tickets → Paris Louvre 6-people Tour with Pre-Reserved Tickets
Rijksmuseum tickets → Rijksmuseum Amsterdam Ticket and Canal Cruise with Audio Guide
